ios.desc:
Remove YouTube Shorts completely.

You won’t see Shorts anywhere—no feed, no search results, no recommendations.
A cleaner, calmer YouTube experience without falling into constant scrolling loops.

Stay focused on what matters, without short-form distractions.
Enjoy a more intentional YouTube experience every time you browse.

Please note: Shorts Blocker exclusively functions with the Safari browser on iPhone, iPad, and Mac devices and is not compatible with the YouTube app.

quotes.text:
I have no affiliation with Shorts Blocker, but I installed it a long time ago and immediately forgot that shorts existed. Worth whatever I paid for it.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shorts-blocker-for-youtube/id6451330524
quotes.story_title: YouTube users get option to set their Shorts time limit to zero minutes
